# Draft:Russian Ukranian War

----
Russian or the Russian Federation is the world’s largest country by land mass, having 11 time zones across Europe and Asia. The population is about 142-147 million people, Moscow is its capital and largest city. Russia is a major global energy supplier with a lot of natural resources. It is also known for its cold weather, and the biggest forest on Earth called The Taiga.
It was colonized in the early Paleolithic. The East Slavs came to Europe between the 3rd and 8th centuries AD. The first East slavic state was taken by the Orthodox Christianity from the Byzantine Empire.  But in the 13th century this led to the Tsardom of Russia in 1547. The Russian revolution of 1917 led to the Monarchic system being gone and replaced by the Russian Socialist Federation Soviet Republic or the USSR. After the Russian civil war Soviet Russia came about the soviet union. There were many deaths when Joseph Stalin came to power. In 1991, the Russian Government came down and got rid of the Soviet Union and came up with a federal Semi presidential System. The leader has been Vladimir Putin. Post-soviet Russia has been going into wars such as Georgia in 2008 and its war with Ukraine since 2014.
Russia is a great power and holds influence. It has a large number of nuclear weapons and has the third largest military in the world. Russia relies on its mineral and energy resources, mainly oil and natural gas. Russia continues to be very low on democracy, human rights, and media freedom, while having high levels of corruption. Stalin also proposed the first five year plan. Getting rid of the NEP was the first number of plans he had. As a part of the plan, the government took control of agriculture through the state and collective farms.
